title: Albert Einstein's Life In Reverse, From Princeton Back to Ulm #Shorts
description:
Albert Einstein's life runs backwards, from his death in a Princeton hospital in 1955 to his birth in the German city of Ulm in 1879. The five steps pass the 1939 letter to Roosevelt, the eclipse of 1919, the four papers of 1905 and the entrance examination he failed as a boy. Dates follow the documented record.

Made with AI assistance.

#AlbertEinstein #Biography #LifeInReverse #Shorts #Physics #Relativity #Documentary

scenes.narration: He died in a Princeton hospital in 1955 at seventy-six, with a doctor keeping his brain for study and his ashes scattered in secret.
Step backwards and eclipse photographs of 1919 show his equations were right, and a clerk unknown outside physics becomes a name printed around the world.
Further back he is in a Bern patent office in 1905, publishing four papers with no university post and nobody to check his work.
Before that he fails the general part of a school entrance examination at sixteen and finishes his courses quietly in a Swiss teacher's house.
At the start there is a child born in 1879 in Ulm on the Danube, whose father sold electrical goods and whose mother put a violin in his hands.
